To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
interstrain aggression is differentially expressed in hypertensive and hyperactive rats.
the four strains of rats differ in their expression of allogrooming, and that females are more aggressive than males.
interstrain aggression in hypertensives and/or hyperactives is differentially expressed in four inbred rat strains derived from Wistar Kyoto (WKY) rat stock: SHRs, WKYs, WKHAs, and WKHT.
In summary, our research is concerned with
genetic and environmental influences on the development and expression of aggressive behavior in the SHR.
the genetic basis of hypertension and hyperactivity, and with the genetic basis for the behavioral responses to interstrain aggression.
the genetic and environmental bases of the expression of aggression in the four rat strains.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the genetic expression of aggression is complex.
the four strains, SHR, WKY,WKHA, WKHT, are not equivalent to each other, but that each is a unique strain.
aggression is not an all-or-none phenomenon, but is expressed in different ways in different strains, and in females and in males.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the genetic basis of interstrain aggression is complex, and that the behavioral responses to this form of aggression are also complex.
aggression in the rat is a complex behavioral response that is not expressed by all strains and is differentially expressed in strains that are genetically related.
the genetic basis of hypertension is complex, involving multiple genes, with the possibility that the same genes may be involved in hyperactivity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
aggression, like blood pressure and activity level, can be genetically dissociated from one another.

the genetic basis of the behavioral response to aggression is not simple, and that the genetic background of the subject and the genetic makeup of the opponent both contribute to the expression of this response.
aggression, like hypertension and hyperactivity, is a complex trait that is differentially expressed in the four strains.
